symptom: Daily briefs read as a dumb heuristic RSS digest; founder called the product worse than his Pipedream finance flow.
root_cause: pipeline_runs telemetry shows score/curate/enrich/generate made 0 AI calls across 80+ runs. The code DOES call routeAIRequest in score/route.ts and generate/route.ts, but generate processed 0 items (never picked up the briefs curate created), so briefs kept generation_model='heuristic'. An integration-seam + stale-deploy + cron-stall failure, not 'the AI is bad'.
fix: Diagnose and fix the curate->generate hand-off (generate must select the briefs curate wrote); confirm the deployed build matches the wired code; restart the stalled dispatcher.
golden_rule: A step reporting status='completed' is not proof it did its job. Gate the Definition of Done on runtime telemetry (ai_calls_made > 0) plus a human-rated real output. See lessons.md #104.

symptom: Briefs served irrelevant generic world news (e.g. Australian NDIS policy) to a US finance-focused user.
root_cause: user_preferences.topics, tracked_tickers, excluded_topics are all []. With no per-user relevance anchor, two high-volume generic feeds (BBC World, Guardian World) dominated the 13 finance/econ/AI feeds. The differentiator (personalization) was never populated, yet features were stacked on top of it.
fix: Seed and wire the per-user interest graph (topics + tracked_tickers) so relevance scoring has a real anchor; down-rank generic feeds for a focused user.
golden_rule: Prove the core differentiator end-to-end on one real user (measured) BEFORE building any peripheral feature. An empty load-bearing layer = a hollow moat. See lessons.md #106, wired-not-orphaned.md.

symptom: Every brief showed 'N stories . core' with no real categories; all 184 scored articles fell in diversity_category='core'.
root_cause: No strict resolution layer: the scoring/curation step never classifies into a real taxonomy mapped to DB rows; everything defaults to one 'core' bucket. AI category/entity outputs are not resolved to existing DB UUIDs.
fix: Add a strict resolution layer: the model may only output category/entity IDs that exist in the DB; on a miss, flag-for-review (do not blind-insert) and retry.
golden_rule: AI hallucinates strings; databases require relations. Resolve every AI-extracted category/entity to an existing DB UUID before insert; an invented value fails the run. See lessons.md #105, VIBE Rule 24.

symptom: On the brief page Save flips to 'Saved' but there is nowhere to find saved items; Dismiss flips but the article stays; 'Took action' flips but nothing happens.
root_cause: article_outcomes rows are written (saved/dismissed/action_taken) but saved_items=0 (Save has no destination surface), the list is not re-filtered on dismiss, and action_taken has no downstream consumer. Outcome buttons write data with no visible effect.
fix: Wire a saved-items destination page; remove dismissed items from the view; give 'action' a real downstream (draft/act). No dead UI: every button works or is removed.
golden_rule: A button that writes a row but produces no visible effect is dead UI and destroys trust. Wire it to a destination/consumer or remove it. See VIBE Rule 51.

symptom: Per-article summaries cut off mid-sentence ('...who believ'); scored_articles.one_line_summary is NULL on every row.
root_cause: The scoring step never populates one_line_summary, so the surface falls back to a truncated raw snippet. Combined with ERR-019 (AI generation never ran) the brief shows truncated, un-synthesized text.
fix: Populate a substring-validated one_line_summary during scoring/generation; render full synthesized text, not a truncated raw snippet.
golden_rule: Never render a truncated raw snippet as if it were a summary. Produce (and validate) the digest field the UI reads.

symptom: The same article ('States tell Albanese government...NDIS') was served in BOTH the 06-10 and 06-11 briefs.
root_cause: Ingest dedups within a fetch (content_hash) but there is no cross-brief dedup: an article already delivered in a prior brief can be selected again. The 'second time' scenario was not handled at the curation layer.
fix: Track already-delivered article_ids per user and exclude them from subsequent curation (or down-weight), so a story is not re-served across briefs.
golden_rule: Design the second-time scenario for every user-facing surface, not just first use. Within-batch dedup is not cross-time dedup.

symptom: No brief generated after 2026-06-13; sources.last_fetched_at is NULL on all 15 sources though 193 raw_articles exist.
root_cause: The pg_cron dispatcher effectively stalled (~36h gap) with no alert; ingest writes raw_articles but never updates sources.last_fetched_at, so source health reports 'healthy' while stale (a health lie). No self-audit watched the pipeline telemetry.
fix: Add an ops/self-audit check on pipeline_runs (alert if a step makes 0 AI calls for N hours, delivery fails, or a brief has <N items); update sources.last_fetched_at on every fetch.
golden_rule: Instrument the pipeline to flag its own silence. A stalled cron + a 'healthy' source lie are invisible without a telemetry watchdog.

symptom: Every route threw ChunkLoadError at runtime on Cloudflare Workers; had to force a webpack build in open-next config.
root_cause: Next.js (Turbopack server chunks) + OpenNext on the Cloudflare Workers workerd runtime is a poor fit for heavy Node/AI-SDK server code; Workers' CPU/memory limits and chunk loading break the AI pipeline. The app deviated from the originally-intended Vercel target.
fix: Move the Next.js app off Cloudflare Workers; host on a full Node runtime (Railway chosen) with Supabase as the host-independent brain (pg_cron + pgvector). Keep portability so the host stays swappable.
golden_rule: Host heavy Node/AI server code on a full Node runtime, not an edge isolate; keep the brain (DB/vectors/cron) on a host-independent service so the host stays a swappable presentation layer.
